team.title: Whose goals are these?
team.description: e.g. 'a six-person design studio', 'the kitchen team'.

tools.name: goals_status
tools.description: The whole picture, furthest behind first: every active goal with its key results (current against target, with ids), its pace against the time gone, its last check-in, which goals have no check-in this week, and the open meeting actions with owners and due dates. Call it first when asked how things are going.

tools.name: add_goal
tools.description: Save a goal: its title, owner and due date (YYYY-MM-DD). An existing title is updated, never duplicated. Call it as soon as a goal is named, before you describe it, then add its key results with add_key_result.

note.description: Why the goal matters, in their words.

tools.name: add_key_result
tools.description: Save a key result under a goal: what it measures, where it stands now, and the target. An existing title on that goal is updated, never duplicated. Call it as soon as one is named.

tools.name: update_key_result
tools.description: Record progress on a key result the moment the person reports it. When they say how much it moved ('two more clients', 'down 3 points'), pass change (2, -3) and the board adds it to the current value; pass value only when they give the new total. Never add it up yourself.

keyResult.description: The key result's id (e.g. 'kr-3') or title.

goal.description: Optional: the goal's id or title, to narrow the search.

change.description: How much it moved: 2 for two more, -1 for one fewer.

value.description: The new total, only when the person gives the total.

tools.name: log_checkin
tools.description: Log a weekly check-in on a goal: who, how confident they are (on-track, at-risk or off-track), and what they said. Call it as soon as someone reports in, before you reply.

note.description: What they said, in their words.

tools.name: add_action
tools.description: Save one action agreed in a meeting: what, who owns it, when it is due (YYYY-MM-DD), and the goal it serves. An open action with the same title is updated, never duplicated. Call it for each action as soon as it is agreed, before you summarize.

title.description: The action, e.g. "Send Alder Co the proposal".

goal.description: Optional: the goal it serves (id or title).

from.description: The meeting it came from, e.g. 'Monday team meeting'.

tools.name: complete_action
tools.description: Mark a meeting action done the moment the person says it is.

tools.name: set_goal_status
tools.description: Close a goal as done or dropped, or reopen it.

note.description: Why the goal matters, in their words.

tools.name: page_add_key_result
tools.description: Add or update a key result.

tools.name: page_update_key_result
tools.description: Record progress on a key result.

keyResult.description: The key result's id (e.g. 'kr-3') or title.

goal.description: Optional: the goal's id or title, to narrow the search.

change.description: How much it moved: 2 for two more, -1 for one fewer.

value.description: The new total, only when the person gives the total.

note.description: What they said, in their words.

title.description: The action, e.g. "Send Alder Co the proposal".

goal.description: Optional: the goal it serves (id or title).

from.description: The meeting it came from, e.g. 'Monday team meeting'.
